newsitem.title: USA: AT&T names Daniel Somers CFO.
newsitem.headline: AT&T names Daniel Somers CFO.

text.p: AT&T Corp said Wednesday it named Daniel Somers chief financial officer and senior executive vice president.
Somers, whose new assignment will take effect in mid-May, is the current chairman and chief executive of Bell Cablemedia Plc, an affiliate of BCE Inc's Bell Canada.
He succeeds Richard Miller, who left the company in March to pursue other interests.
Somers, who will direct financial strategy and organization for the telecommunications giant, will report to Robert Allen, AT&T's chairman and chief executive, and be part of the chairman's office.
"Dan's broad skills and accomplishments make him ideally suited for the CFO role at this pivotal point in AT&T's history," Allen said in a company statement.
"An outstanding financial executive who also has an operations background, Dan brings valuable experience in the international telecommunications industry and competitive consumer businesses."

During his two years at Bell Cablemedia, Somers helped create London's largest cable provider, Cable & Wireless Communications, by merging several British cable interests, including Bell Cablemedia, into the new entity, now owned largely by Cable and Wireless Plc.
From 1992 to 1995, Somers was executive vice president and chief financial officer for Bell Canada International Inc.
AT&T shares were up 1/4 to 33-1/2 in afternoon trading on the New York Stock Exchange.
